required_roles: complete object inventory and schema coverage
stages.scope: ratified CPU/no-model implementation and fixtures only
runtime validity evidence for the exact run only

required_roles: paired, safety, missingness, assay, Holm, overlap, scope, and dependency receipts
stages.scope: construction of exact claim_dependency_map release strings and fixed qualifications only

stage_receipt_rule: Each stage has its own closed schema. Artifact type, stage, exact predecessor receipt, role-named exact-cardinality subjects, scope, decision, reachable value, and self hash are fixed by schema and recomputed by the authority reducer. Passed/reachable Booleans supplied by the subject are never trusted. Reduction first emits claim_decision_receipts; PRE_SCIENTIFIC_CLAIM authority consumes those decisions; only then may claim_release receipts consume that authority. A release receipt is never an ancestor of its own authority.
human_receipt_rule: Architecture and run ratification each bind the exact evidence path, evidence hash, verbatim excerpt, decision owner, authorized scope, forbidden scope, subject hashes, and predecessor. The two decisions are non-substitutable.
sealer_rule: Exactly two static seals are required. Their implementation IDs and complete source-tree hashes must differ; a typed independence receipt verifies distinct implementations and exact output agreement. Two executions of one implementation do not qualify.
review_rule: A fresh reviewer must pass the exact run lock/seals/evidence. The advocate may explain or recommend repair but cannot override or convert a failed review.
preflight_rule: Before every dispatch, preflight reloads source artifacts and recomputes the complete PRE_MODEL_EXECUTION chain; verifies executable, run-lock, artifact, immediate-state, and dispatch-class hashes; and emits a self-hashed permit or denial. Denial, stale predecessor, missing role, duplicate role, or hash mismatch starts no process.
